title: the reference pages name the notebook of an example after every code cell
author: Claude-JG
description: The maintainer, 2026-10-05: in the pages of the Python-C++ interface, '(from the notebook ...)' follows every code cell that comes from a notebook; it shall appear once per notebook and page, after its first code cell, smaller and directly under the cell, and only the file name.
releaseNotes: The pages of the Python-C++ interface name the notebook an example comes from once, after its first code cell on the page, as its file name, small and directly under the cell.
